requested_role: replace manual visual input review with DeepSeek Flash

successful_evidence.inputs: Two contact sheets; no complete per-frame video review
successful_evidence.result: The official model returned valid structured visual judgments in 21 seconds. Its output is retained for user inspection and is not treated as ground truth.

earlier_local_alias_issue.interpretation: This local alias did not declare image or video input and was not the correct route to the official deepseek-flash visual model. An attempted harness subagent also rejected the model argument before starting. These interface facts are not evidence that the official model lacks vision.

delegated_session_issue.interpretation: Before the official call, the local text-only CLI session delegated image reading to other configured VLMs and timed out before producing its own JSON. Those observations belong to the delegated models, not to DeepSeek.

current_conclusion: Use the official deepseek-flash API for subsequent visual gates. The first prompt did not distinguish mesh-reconstruction reference frames from contact-analysis frames, so its reference-time choices cannot by itself establish or refute the model's ability to select reconstruction inputs. A separate explicit mesh-reference prompt is required.
